name: Ziph
overview: Ziph was a male member of the tribe of Judah, identified specifically as the son of Jehallelel. His mention in Scripture is brief and does not include additional personal details or notable events. He is recorded in the genealogical listings of the tribe of Judah.
namesAndTitles: The name 'Ziph' appears as a proper name in Scripture without any given meaning or divine origin noted. It is simply recorded as the name of this individual in 1 Chronicles 4:16.
familyAndRelationships: Ziph is explicitly identified as the son of Jehallelel. Beyond this paternal relationship, Scripture does not provide further information about his family or other connections.
scriptureSignificance: Ziph's significance lies primarily in his inclusion in the genealogical records of Judah, which underscore the faithfulness of God's covenant people through successive generations. His mention helps preserve the lineage and heritage important to the biblical narrative, even though no further narrative details are provided.
